an3.24:1.1: 'me bhikkhave puggalā puggalassa bahukārā. Katame tayo? Yaṃ bhikkhave puggalaṃ āgamma puggalo buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, ayaṃ puggalo imassa puggalassa bahukāro.
an3.24:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yaṃ puggalaṃ āgamma puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ bhikkhave puggalo imassa puggalassa bahukāro.
an3.24:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yaṃ puggalaṃ āgamma puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ puggalo imassa puggalassa bahukāro. Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā puggalassa bahukārā.
an3.24:4.1: Imehi ca pana bhikkhave tīhi puggalehi imassa puggalassa n' atthi añño puggalo bahukārataro ti vadāmi. Imesañ ca bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ iminā puggalena na suppaṭikāraṃ vadāmī ti, yadidaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikamma-cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānuppadānenā ti. Tayo
